title: build_eval_command output
description: Output schema for the build_eval_command method — the adapter's non-interactive, one-shot invocation used as a hidden judge for atrium's emulated /goal and /loop. The command reads its prompt from stdin and must print the model's reply to stdout. atrium runs it OUT OF BAND: a separate process and a separate engine session, so the user's conversation is never polluted and the judge cannot be steered by the pane. Adapters that have no headless mode omit this method; atrium then falls back to count/duration-bounded loops with no completion evaluation.

command.description: The command and arguments for one headless judge turn. Must accept the prompt on STDIN and emit the reply on STDOUT. Should disable approvals/interactivity — a judge that blocks on a prompt hangs the evaluation until its timeout.

acceptsPromptFile.description: True when the command expects the prompt as a file path appended as a final argument instead of on stdin. atrium writes a temp file and appends its path.
